rules.answer_text: Forty years I knew them. And I'll tell you something for nothing: last week, in the cafe, I heard them say to somebody — quiet, but furious, the way they got — 'You have until tomorrow.' Never saw who. Kitchen doorway, my back was to it. But Isabella Reed didn't threaten people for sport. Somebody in this village was living on borrowed time, and I'd say the loan came due.

rules.answer_text: Nadia Cole went out the front just before the quarter hour and turned towards the square. Now here's the thing — she says fountain, I hear. I face that fountain, young detective. My eyes aren't what they were, and I did have my crossword. But I don't recall seeing her at it. Priya Shah, though — you should have heard her this morning. That's your man, I'd stake my pension.
